      - name: Checkout writable source branch

jobs:
  persist-recovery:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout writable head branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
          fetch-depth: 1
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: Rebuild complete recovery corpus
        run: npm run knowledge:excavate-and-marry
      - name: Enforce no-loss recovery floor and cross-stage equality
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node <<'NODE'
          const fs=require('fs');
          const m=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/manifest.json','utf8'));
          const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/photo-marriage/crosswalk.json','utf8'));
          const a=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/semantic-archive/archive-manifest.json','utf8'));
          const floor=28862;
          if(m.totalRecords < floor) throw new Error(`recovery regression: ${m.totalRecords} < verified floor ${floor}`);
          if(x.totalRecords !== m.totalRecords) throw new Error(`photo-marriage mismatch ${x.totalRecords} != ${m.totalRecords}`);
          if(a.totalRecords !== m.totalRecords) throw new Error(`semantic-archive mismatch ${a.totalRecords} != ${m.totalRecords}`);
          if(m.totalBatches !== 20 && m.totalRecords <= 20*1499) throw new Error(`unexpected batch count ${m.totalBatches}`);
          console.log(JSON.stringify({persistingRecords:m.totalRecords,batches:m.totalBatches,sourceCounts:m.sourceCounts,moduleCounts:m.moduleCounts,reviewCounts:m.reviewCounts},null,2));
          NODE
      - name: Persist generated recovery into pantavion-planet branch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git config user.name 'pantavion-recovery-bot'
          git config user.email 'pantavion-recovery-bot@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add -f data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'Canonical recovery corpus already persisted with no changes.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m 'recovery: persist complete canonical knowledge corpus'
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
      - name: Final persisted-file verification
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test -f data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/full-corpus.json
          test -f data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/manifest.json
          test -f data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/photo-marriage/full-corpus-married.json
          test -f data/recovery/canonical-knowledge-v2/semantic-archive/archive-manifest.json

  id: "pantavion-kernel-os",
  version: KERNEL_VERSION,
  mission:
    "Build, govern and evolve complex real digital ecosystems with controlled self-modernization.",
  doctrine: {
    corePrinciple: "Controlled Sovereign Self-Building",
    rule1: "No chaotic self-modification.",
    rule2: "Kernel is the single source of truth.",
    rule3: "All important changes must be remembered.",
    rule4: "All execution must be auditable.",
    rule5: "Core architecture cannot be broken by extensions.",
    rule6: "Evolution must be reviewable and reversible.",
    rule7: "Pantavion core surfaces remain ad-free outside Ads Center."
  },
  modules: [
    "Kernel",
    "People",
    "Chat",
    "Voice",
    "Pulse",
    "Compass",
    "Mind",
    "Create",
    "PantaLearn",
    "Tools Hub",
    "Business Layer",
    "Research Layer",
    "Ads Center"
  ] satisfies KernelModuleKey[],
  deliveryModes: [
    "native-feature",
    "connector",
    "catalog",
    "course",
    "workflow"
  ] satisfies DeliveryMode[]
};

    isolationStrength: 'critical-hard',

    memoryPartitioned: true,
    exportPartitioned: true,
    keyMaterialSeparated: true,
    notes: ['Per-user memory must not bleed across tenants.'],
  },

    isolationKey: 'thread-boundary-isolation',
    title: 'Thread Boundary Isolation',
    isolationStrength: 'hard',
